about.text: Aarts is a fresh, semi-solid curd of Mongolia, made by heating yoghurt and draining it through a cloth sack, then pressing it under a heavy stone until the liquid is gone. It is eaten cool or frozen, or boiled into a hot drink, and is the base for khuruud and aaruul.
